The '''Morshdine sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], rimward of [[Amorris]]. [[Wesselman]] planned to go acquire unregistered [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna gas]] from Morshdine, but was arrested by a [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] agent.
